cover_sub: Made to measure for Stamford’s period and family homes, handcrafted in our Peterborough workshop, a short drive away.
welcome_lead: Stamford’s Georgian townhouses, stone cottages and conservation-area homes are rarely a standard shape, which is exactly why we build to measure.
welcome_body: Every kitchen, wardrobe and bedroom is made to your room’s exact sizes, so period proportions, chimney breasts, sloping ceilings and awkward corners are no problem. We’re a Peterborough workshop, not a national chain: the same team designs your room, makes it at Brassey Close and fits it.
local_intro: Tall Georgian rooms, cottage alcoves or a box room in a newer house: each piece is drawn for the space it’s going into.
local_cards: Tall ceilings are ideal for full-height wardrobes and floor-to-ceiling kitchen storage that suit the room’s proportions.
Walls are rarely straight and ceilings rarely level, so we scribe every cabinet and filler to the room.
Where rooms are regular but space is tight, well-planned corners and tall units make every centimetre work.
area_text: As well as Stamford itself, we design and fit in the surrounding villages, and plan van access and delivery times for narrow town-centre streets before fitting starts.
wardrobe_text: Full-height fitted wardrobes make the most of Stamford’s tall Georgian rooms, and alcove furniture either side of a chimney breast is a natural fit in the older cottages.
fit_text: Our own fitters install everything, usually in one to two weeks. Stamford is about half an hour away, so return visits are easy.
faqs: How far is Stamford from your workshop?
About 15 miles, or 25 to 30 minutes on the A47 and A1. Design visits, final measures and fitting days are easy to arrange, and if anything needs a return visit we can usually be back the same week.
Can you fit a kitchen in an older Stamford townhouse or cottage?
Yes. Walls in stone houses are rarely straight, so every cabinet and filler is scribed to the room rather than forcing standard units into it.
Can I see your work before I book?
Yes. Our showroom is at 3 Brassey Close, Peterborough PE1 2AZ, about half an hour from Stamford. Call 01733 686767 to arrange a time.
local_paras: Stamford was England’s first conservation area. Fitted furniture usually needs no consent, but work that touches original fabric, such as removing a wall or altering a chimney breast, may. We point out anything like that at the survey so you can check with South Kesteven District Council.
